formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiCF3SO3 system. Intermediate compound stoichiometry P(EO3LiCF3SO3). Eutectic composition near O/Li = 100.
formulations.Notes: Data points read from Fig. 5 and Fig. 6. Conductivity values are approximate estimates from the log10(sigma) vs 1/T plots. Activation energy ~0.7 eV for T > 60C. Eutectic melting temperature ~65C.
formulations.Reference: Robitaille and Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiClO4 system. Intermediate compounds P(EO3LiClO4) and P(EO6LiClO4). Monotectic behavior.
formulations.Notes: Data points read from Fig. 10 and Fig. 11. Conductivity values are approximate estimates from the log10(sigma) vs 1/T plots. Activation energy ~0.7 eV for T > 60C. Eutectic melting temperature ~50C. Monotectic behavior between P(EO3LiClO4) and P(EO6LiClO4).
formulations.Reference: Robitaille and Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiAsF6 system. Intermediate compounds P(EO3LiAsF6) and P(EO6LiAsF6). Isomorphous with P(EO6LiClO4).
formulations.Notes: Data points read from Fig. 16 and Fig. 17. Conductivity values are approximate estimates from the log10(sigma) vs 1/T plots. Activation energy ~0.6-0.7 eV for T > 60C. Eutectic melting temperature ~55C. Electrolytes with X > 0.35 are thermally unstable.
formulations.Reference: Robitaille and Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)
